frozen_windows.window_definition: inclusive UTC calendar dates from earth_date-radius through earth_date+radius
frozen_windows.observation_opportunity_hit: At least one materialized Palomar observation-day row exists inside the frozen window.

primary_statistics.T_r: For each radius r in {0,1,3}, number of the six primary holdout site-dates with at least one Palomar observation opportunity in its window.

secondary_statistics.S_r: For each radius, number of the three primary sites with at least one hit among that site's frozen event dates.
secondary_statistics.U_r_actual: Number of unique Palomar observation days in the union of the six actual windows; descriptive only unless an exact preregistered null is implemented without changing the primary contract.

primary_null.name: INDEPENDENT_SITE_CLUSTER_RIGID_TRANSLATION_EXHAUSTIVE
primary_null.description: Each site's entire frozen date cluster is translated by its own integer-day shift. All dates within a site move together, preserving event count and all within-site pairwise day separations. Only shifts for which every translated plus/minus-3-day window remains inside the Palomar study window are admissible.
primary_null.exact_enumeration_contract: For each site and radius, enumerate the full site-specific rigid-shift hit-count histogram. Because T_r is additive across independently shifted sites, obtain the exact aggregate T_r histogram by integer-count convolution of the three site histograms rather than Monte Carlo or explicit giant Cartesian expansion.
preserves: number of frozen event dates per site
required_outputs: site-specific admissible shift ranges and counts
site-specific event-hit histograms for each radius
fraction of null shift vectors with T_r >= actual T_r
maximum T_r and number of shift vectors reaching it

seasonality_sensitivity_null.name: INDEPENDENT_SITE_CLUSTER_CALENDAR_YEAR_SHIFT_EXHAUSTIVE
seasonality_sensitivity_null.description: Each site's cluster is translated only by an integer number of calendar years, keeping month/day fixed for every event and preserving within-site cluster geometry for this cohort. Only year shifts whose full plus/minus-3-day windows remain inside the study window are admissible.
seasonality_sensitivity_null.purpose: Sensitivity control for seasonality/calendar-position effects in the Palomar observation schedule.
seasonality_sensitivity_null.exact_enumeration_contract: Enumerate every admissible integer-year shift per site and convolve the site-specific hit-count histograms exactly for T_r.
required_outputs: site-specific event-hit histograms for each radius
fraction of null year-shift vectors with T_r >= actual T_r

site_balance_control.reason: A temporal excess concentrated entirely in one site must remain distinguishable from an excess distributed across independently sourced sites.

known_outcome_calibration.rule: Do not append Oak Ridge to the six holdout event dates when computing T_r or its p-like null tail fractions.

interpretation_contract.temporal_hit_means_only: Palomar had at least one materialized observation day inside the preregistered Earth-date window.
temporal_hit_does_not_mean: a candidate on a Palomar plate corresponds to the Earth event
interpretation_contract.no_temporal_hit_means_only: No materialized Palomar observation opportunity existed in that frozen temporal window.
interpretation_contract.next_stage_if_temporal_excess_survives: A separately preregistered R5 plate/sky/candidate-level test; no candidate-level fishing is authorized by R4 alone.

promotion_rule.required: Report all three radii and both null families regardless of direction. Do not select a favorable radius or null after execution.
promotion_rule.strong_temporal_signal_language_allowed_: The upper-tail rarity is small under the primary null and the direction remains materially consistent under the seasonality sensitivity null; exact thresholds must be reported numerically rather than converted into an origin claim.

canonical_seal: THE EARTH COHORT IS FROZEN BEFORE THE SKY CALENDAR IS OPENED. MOVE WHOLE SITE CLUSTERS, REPORT EVERY RADIUS AND BOTH NULLS, AND NEVER TURN OBSERVATION OPPORTUNITY INTO ORIGIN.
